questions.question: Round 245 368 to the nearest 10, 100 and 1 000.
questions.expected_answer: To the nearest 10 it is 245 370 (units digit 8). To the nearest 100 it is 245 400 (tens digit 6). To the nearest 1 000 it is 245 000 (hundreds digit 3).
